name: Arisu Yuuji
source:
Key Emotion: Sense of emptiness

The protagonist of the story who is a second-year student. He is fairly popular, has good grades and is good at sports. However, he has some trouble socializing with people due to the nickname "Liar Prince" he received when he was younger, which also became a kind of trauma for him. Yuji has the special power to counter those with "Princess Syndromes", as he is able to use his "Prince" powers to calm them down.
